newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: BWT surges 7 pct to record new year high.
newsitem.headline: BWT surges 7 pct to record new year high.

text.p: Shares in BWT, a maker of water-treatment technology, soared seven percent in a limp Vienna market on Wednesday, on persistent follow-through buying that has driven the price up 22 percent in the last month.
At 1238 GMT, BWT was up 7.24 percent, or 105 schillings, to a new year high of 1,555 schillings on volume of 14,800 lots. The blue chip ATX index was down 0.7 percent.
"There's one big buyer -- a domestic bank -- but I can't say who it's on behalf of," said one trader in Vienna.

BWT has seen persistent demand since the company announced in March it was developing a new water-treatment technology that it expected would bring in extra sales of 700 million schillings in the year 2001.

Shorter term, BWT said it expects the technology, that prevents the formation of lime without the use of chemicals or salt, to bring in extra sales of 200 million schillings and earnings of 56 million next year.
BWT was Vienna's best performing stock last month, surging over 20 percent. -- Julia Ferguson, Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 256
